chapter: New Orleans bands, brass bands and learning bass
title: Playing bass drum and cymbals in parades
summary: Garland mostly played drums in parades and explains how he used cymbals with the bass drum, on and after the beat.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Early drum kits and the gear drummers used

blocks.x: Did you ever play in parades much?
Oh yeah, but I mean, what is it? Oh yeah, oh yeah.
I played drums. I played drums most of the time. Which one? I played bass drum. Yeah, I played good bass drum. I played it lately so I can't walk no more in a parade. I played bass drum.
You still play bass drum once in a while in a parade out in Los Angeles. What about cymbals?
Cymbals too. How did you work that then in those two? The cymbals and the bass drum? I used the cymbals and the bass drum.
I used the same thing, yeah. The cymbals on the top and the while beat them. Same old time.
Same thing. After beats usually? Oh yeah. On the cymbals?
After beat, would you come down on the after beat on the cymbals? Oh yeah. On the beat?
No, I'll come on the beat and sometimes after beat. Both ways. Both ways. Both ways. On and after.
